description: Execute a flow and return its outputs synchronously. Runs the draft by default; pass source:"published" (optionally a version) to run the live published version. Spends workspace LLM budget, bounded by the token's cost cap. `input` is the flow's input envelope, e.g. {"kind":"chat","messages":[…]} or {"kind":"form","values":{…}}.

approvalId.description: Re-call with the approvalId from a needs_confirmation response after the user approves.

input.description: Flow input envelope (RunFlowInput). Omit for a flow that needs none.

source.description: Which version to run. Default: draft.

timeoutMs.description: Max runtime in ms (also the hard cost ceiling).

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_flows_run
title: Run a Workbench flow
